issues: Challenge in these appeals is to the order of a learned Single Judge of the Punjab and Haryana High Court.
The petition was dismissed in the light of a judgment of this Court in Sunder Vs. Union of India (2001 (7) SCC 211).
One other question also was sought to be raised and answered by this Bench though not referred to it.

Whether in the light of the decision in Sunder 2001 Indlaw SC 67 (supra), the awardee/decree holder would be entitled to claim interest on solatium in execution though it is not specifically granted by the decree.
